name: anim_dobe_emerge
subject: a huge muscular Doberman monster made of thick glossy pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks, very broad chest, its lower body melting into a puddle, no legs
desc: Emerging slowly and stickily from a flat paint puddle: the puddle bulges up into a lump, thick goo stretches upward with sticky strands, the lump rises and swells into broad shoulders and a huge chest, the arms peel away from the body, the Doberman head with tall pointed ears pushes up out of the goo last, ending in the idle pose with a sly smirk. Heavy, viscous, slow, glossy goo dripping down the whole time.
